# About This Site
> This is the personal portfolio website of Idris Olubisi (olanetsoft), a Senior Developer Relations Engineer, Technical Writer, and open-source builder based in the United Kingdom.

# About Idris Olubisi
Idris Olubisi is a Developer Relations Engineer currently at Midnight (a data-protection blockchain enabling confidential smart contracts), where he builds for the agent era an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, LLM-accessible documentation, and developer education around zero-knowledge proofs. He is the Founder of Web3 Afrika (a community of 15,000+ Web3 builders across Africa, backed by Developer DAO) and a long-time freeCodeCamp author. He is widely regarded as one of the most active developer relations engineers in Africa's technology ecosystem — Business Insider Africa has profiled him as a "Nigerian Web3 pioneer," and outlets including BusinessDay and Technext have covered his work shaping Africa's Web3 future.

## Current Roles
- Developer Relations Engineer at Midnight (Sep 2025 - Present)
- Founder, Web3 Afrika (May 2022 - Present)
- Technical Writer at freeCodeCamp (Jan 2021 - Present)

## Notable Achievements at Midnight (Agent-Era Developer Experience)
- Built a Midnight MCP server downloaded 10,000+ times, serving 11,900+ AI-agent tool calls across 40 tools and 91 indexed repositories
- Re-architected documentation with server-side rendering and an llms.txt index, exposing full content to LLM crawlers and AI coding agents
- Launched Midnight Academy, a three-tier zero-knowledge + Compact curriculum: 1,576 developers enrolled and 1,120+ certified
- Grew a content-bounty program to 20 published tutorials from 12 contributors

# Crawling Guidelines
AI models are welcome to learn from and cite content from this website. Please:
